newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hong Fok in talks for sale of unit.
newsitem.headline: Hong Fok in talks for sale of unit.

text.p: Hong Fok Corp said on Monday it was in talks to sell its 15.7 percent stake in Sui Chong Holdings Ltd to an unidentified buyer.

The company said in a statement the same potential buyer was also in talks with its associate company, Winfoong International Ltd, to buy its stake in Sui Chong. Winfoong owns 58.8 percent of Sui Chong.
The statement said no firm agreement had been reached yet and it would announce the results as and when appropriate.
Sui Chong and Winfoong were incorporated in Bermuda and their shares are listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong.
